title: Liquid AI reveals 8B-A1B MoE trained on 38T
summary: Liquid AI announced their LFM 2.5-8B-A1B, a Mixture of Experts (MoE) language model with 8 billion parameters that activates only 1 billion per token, trained on 38 trillion tokens - a substantial training corpus for a relatively small model.
problem_solved: Provides an efficient sparse MoE model that achieves good performance with lower computational cost per inference by activating only a fraction of parameters per forward pass.
why_valuable: The 38T token training dataset combined with MoE architecture offers a balance of model quality and inference efficiency, making powerful AI more accessible.
